fichas.title: Carpenter’s Shop: Planning and Functional Scheme
fichas.summary: The layout of a carpenter’s shop is planned using operational data about equipment, utilisation, costs, power, floor loadings, space, production, staffing, organisation and workflow. Planning also considers materials, stores, energy supply and waste. The functional scheme shows work and support spaces arranged around access from the yard and street.
uses: Store materials and finished or in-process work
Provide administrative, social, and support functions
Supply heat, electricity, and compressed air
figure_refs: 1 Functional scheme of a carpentry and woodworking business

fichas.title: Example of a Turnery
fichas.summary: A turnery plan illustrates the arrangement of woodworking machines and work areas. The equipment key identifies lathes, turning and finishing equipment, drilling and milling machines, saws, sanding machines, work benches, and a waste-wood heating boiler.

fichas.title: Example of a Woodworking Business
fichas.summary: Ground-floor and first-floor examples show a woodworking business with solid-wood and board stores, a small-machine store, machine and bench production, heating, a sawdust silo, foreman’s office, break room, and washroom. The ground-floor drawing labels a setting-out floor and stair-mortising machine; the plans also identify a changing room and a heating arrangement.
uses: Store solid wood, boards, and small machines
Carry out machine and bench production
Set out work and perform stair mortising
Provide staff, washing, changing, and heating facilities
furniture_equipment: Combined heating boiler for oil and waste wood

WORKSHOPS
Carpenter's Shop

The layout of the carpenter's shop can be planned on the basis of
the following operational data:
Equipment, utilisation, cost-effectiveness, power requirements,
floor loadings, space requirement, cost, production process, production times, number of employees, technical organisation of the
business, operating procedures and working sequence
Materials: types, quantities, weights, space requirement
Stores: size, space requirement
Energy supply: heat, electricity, compressed air.
Waste products: types, space requirement, waste disposal.
